messages:
Sam (CS): Quick alert — a handful of EU onboarding attempts are returning 401s starting ~01:05 UTC. I exported the impacted roster (5 trials, 2 enterprise). Dropping here to coordinate a customer note and remediation plan. Link: https://go/internal/cs/impacted-auth-eu (view).
Ivy (eng-oncall): Investigating. Early logs show token introspection failing with TLS handshake errors to our introspection endpoint in eu-west. Looks like the cert chain on the TLS terminator expired and our introspection client rejected the connection. Kicked off cert roll/reload. ETA ~15m.
Rafael (CS Ops): Good to know. If this is cert expiry we should include exact restore time for customers and offer a live troubleshooting slot for enterprise accounts. I'll prepare credits for trials.
Priya (Legal): Credits are fine. Wording guidance: avoid language that could be read as accepting contractual liability. Prefer "we're sorry for the disruption" and state the restore time as "service was available for affected users as of <time>".
status-bot: cert-reload: initiated (job-id cert-reload-2027-02-11-0118)
Ivy (eng-oncall): Cert reload completed at 01:19 UTC. Introspection TLS handshakes are healthy; token introspection success rate back to normal by ~01:22 UTC. Root cause: automated cert renewal job failed to push intermediate chain to eu TLS gateway. Remediation: fix renewal job, add chain validation in CI, and add alert on handshake failures (owners: infra/eng). Postmortem scheduled for 09:00 UTC.
Sam (CS): Drafting an immediate status note for impacted contacts. Will request Priya to review legal phrasing. Draft below.
Sam (CS): --- CUSTOMER STATUS DRAFT ---
Hi <CustomerName>,
We're writing because you may have seen authentication errors during onboarding earlier today. A TLS certificate chain issue affected token validation for some EU sign-ins; service was available for affected users as of 01:22 UTC. If you're still seeing 401s, please try a fresh browser sign-in and include the request timestamp and the x-rw-trace header in your reply so our team can correlate logs quickly.
We're sorry for the disruption. As a gesture, we've applied a 14-day credit to affected trials and scheduled complimentary 1:1 onboarding sessions for impacted enterprise customers. To book troubleshooting office hours, please use: https://cal.link/redwood-cs/office-hours.
If you'd like an immediate diagnostic, reply here with the trace header and timestamp and we'll prioritize it.
---
Priya (Legal): Suggest one small tweak: change "we've applied" to "we have applied" for tone. Also change "service was available" to "service was available for affected users as of 01:22 UTC" (explicit). Otherwise ok.
Sam (CS): Updated per Legal. Planning to send at 01:40 UTC to the impacted contacts and post a portal blurb. Rafael please book 1:1s for the two enterprise accounts and log any renewal cues.
Rafael (CS Ops): Will do. I'll also capture customer feedback and tone in the renewal-risk tracker and attach call notes to the impacted-row in the roster sheet.
Ivy (eng-oncall): Monitoring looks stable; handshake error alarms cleared at 01:25 UTC. I'll include cert chain diff + timeline in the postmortem and add the remediation tasks to the infra backlog.
Sam (CS): Sent customer notes at 01:42 UTC and posted the portal note. Will flag any replies that look like exec escalations or churn risk. Thanks team :pray:
